stock.description: Great Harvest Maeta Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in chartering of dry bulk vessel chartering services worldwide. It operates through Chartering of Vessels, and Property Investment and Development segments. The company owns 2 vessels with total carrying capacity of 150,187 deadweight tonnage. It also provides marine transportation and agency services. The company was formerly known as Great Harvest Maeta Group Holdings Limited and changed its name to Great Harvest Maeta Holdings Limited in September 2021. Great Harvest Maeta Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
